note: Character lessons: how blender/character.py draws each hexagram's character. Rendered by `node scripts/character.mjs --render NUMBER`. Keys are character.py's options in camelCase; see its docstring. The sentence is from series/critic/characters/research.json and is not yet the short's lesson.

characters.story: A tree stands; walls rise round it; it is pressed flat inside them.
A bowl rises; water fills it and spills over the far rim.
Worms breed in a shut bowl, swarm up and pour out.
characters.sentence:
What you leave
shut goes bad

characters.story: Four beams rise as the well's frame; the water in the middle ripples on every beat.
characters.sentence:
The town changes;
the well stays

characters.story: A sprout stands buried to its tip; it pushes up through the ground in three strains, then lies down as the character.
Two lines rise; between them a moon goes from new to full and back, then sets into them; a heart is drawn beside it.
A window rises; beside it a full moon shines, then wanes to a thin crescent that stays lit, and sets into the moon's strokes.
characters.sentence:
Keep your light
low and on

characters.story: The legs rise; a fire is lit among them; the bowl, drawn high above, drops onto them.
characters.sentence:
A steady base
lets things cook

characters.story: The ox and its horn are drawn; a knife rises beside them; the horn lifts free and hovers.
characters.sentence:
Cut it loose
and move on

characters.story: A figure stands; a cloud forms above and rain falls on it; it waits; the rain stops, the cloud comes down and the figure lies down under it.
characters.sentence:
Wait in the rain;
it will pass.

characters.story: A figure with a big eye stands, leans down, and three small squares light up under it one by one; then it lies down as the character.
characters.sentence:
Lean down to
see what is small

characters.story: A figure with a big eye stands, turns round to look back, holds still, turns forward again and lies down as the character.
characters.sentence:
Stop, and look
at where you are

characters.story: A knife stands beside a block; pieces fall off the block one by one until only its base stands; then both lie down as the character.
People under a flag are drawn standing far off; they walk toward you in four hops, then lie down as the character.
A figure's mouth rises open; the two lines above it lift out of it and float, bobbing, like laughter.
characters.sentence:
Joy is better
shared out loud

characters.story: One figure stands; a second stands behind it, then walks up in three hops to stand close beside it; they lie down together as the character.
A frame rises; inside it a board and a mouth are drawn, and all of it inside lifts at once, together, and hovers.
A figure stands; a bowl rises beside it; the meal done, the figure turns its back on the bowl, holds, turns again and lies down as the character.
characters.sentence:
When it is done,
stay awake

characters.story: A passage rises; a foot stands out in front of it, then walks back toward it in four hops; the road it walks is drawn after it.
characters.sentence:
The way out is
the way back
